narrative.iNeed: successful HTTP response payloads for index metadata, query executions, and code snippets to be serialized into valid JSON
narrative.soThat: the console frontend can consume structured data for display and analysis

scenarios.title: Serialize index info success response
given: The query console server receives a valid request for index information
when: handleIndexInfo constructs the workspace and index metadata object
then: The response payload is serialized as JSON and returned with HTTP status 200 and application/json headers
scenarios.observableResult: An HTTP 200 response containing serialized JSON index metadata and counts is delivered to the client
scenarios.conformanceSignal: response.end receives a JSON string built from index metadata with matching Content-Length header

scenarios.title: Serialize query execution receipt response
given: A valid query request body is submitted
when: handleQuery executes the relational query and produces a query receipt
then: The execution receipt is serialized into JSON and returned with HTTP status 200
scenarios.observableResult: An HTTP 200 response containing the serialized query execution receipt is sent to the client
scenarios.conformanceSignal: response.end transmits the JSON stringified query receipt

scenarios.title: Serialize source snippet response
given: A valid snippet query parameter set is provided
when: handleSnippet retrieves the source file lines or determines status
then: The snippet result object is serialized into JSON and returned with HTTP status 200
scenarios.observableResult: An HTTP 200 response with the serialized snippet payload is delivered to the client
scenarios.conformanceSignal: response.end transmits the JSON payload containing availability flag and line objects

obligations.statement: Serialize index summary details and statistics into JSON for index info requests.
Serialize query execution receipts into JSON for successful query requests.
Serialize snippet extraction results and availability into JSON for snippet requests.

queryEvidence.commandText: SELECT bm.mechanic AS mechanic, bm.modulePath AS modulePath, sym.name AS symbolName, sr.startLine AS startLine, sr.endLine AS endLine FROM bodyMechanics bm JOIN sourceReferences sr ON bm.sourceReferenceId = sr.referenceId LEFT JOIN symbols sym ON bm.fromSymbolId = sym.symbolId WHERE bm.mechanic = 'serialization' AND bm.modulePath = 'serves-query-console.runtime.impl.mjs' AND sym.name IN ('handleIndexInfo', 'handleQuery', 'handleSnippet') ORDER BY sr.startLine

modelAssessment.rationale: The bounded source-fact query result and runtime code demonstrate inline JSON response serialization across handleIndexInfo, handleQuery, and handleSnippet within src/console/serves-query-console.runtime.impl.mjs.
